recommended_component.name: Shared-Prompt Gaussian Group Head (gauss.py) on Qwen LoRA Representations
recommended_component.rationale: Models joint prompt effect Z = mu_author + P_prompt + E via WPCA (d=128) and Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage, evaluating injective group marginal probabilities across recovered prompt clusters. In 0.672 it was applied directly to q14v5 (w=0.70) and q8v5 (w=0.44). Operates on continuous semantic representations with zero surface domain shift and zero data leakage. Can produce genuine prompt-disjoint OOF predictions in < 10 seconds of CPU compute.

second_best_candidate.name: Sibling Residuals (sibling_style.py / Roman Tamrazov V40A)
second_best_candidate.rationale: Applies intra-family logistic regressions on 142 style features to re-rank sibling models within Claude, Gemini, GPT, and GLM while strictly preserving provider-level logsumexp probability mass. Directly attacks the primary failure mode of EXP52 (sibling confusion), but relies on surface features which have domain-shift risk.
